terms.comment: A little machine for reckoning, built from late words on classical stems: māchinula is in Paulinus of Nola, calculātōrius, of an accountant, in a scholiast on Juvenal (Lewis & Short).
Leibniz’s name for his calculating machine; Morgan–Owens also gives Egger’s mēchanēma calculātōrium.

terms.gloss: a teacher of arithmetic; an accountant
terms.comment: A false friend: in Martial the arithmetic master, beside the shorthand master, and in the Digest a bookkeeper; not a machine.

phrases.english: Work it out on your fingers, not with the calculator!

sources: Lewis & Short: machinula · Lewis & Short: calculatorius · Lewis & Short: machina · Lewis & Short: calculator
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. calculator.
